ui:media:assets/UI/ProfileOverviewUI.png.title: Player profile & progression
ui:media:assets/UI/ProfileOverviewUI.png.description: A bold purple player profile with a clear level and XP hierarchy, player titles, and unlockable banners. A consistent visual language connects the profile overview and customization panels.

ui:media:assets/UI/Inventory.png.title: Fantasy inventory & equipment
ui:media:assets/UI/Inventory.png.description: A dark fantasy inventory built around readable item categories, an organized item grid, equipment slots, and a separate item details panel. Gold accents make the selected category and equipped item easy to identify.

ui:media:assets/UI/SimulatorHudUI.png.title: Colorful simulator HUD
ui:media:assets/UI/SimulatorHudUI.png.description: A playful simulator interface with distinct currency counters, a level progress bar, and recognizable shortcuts for the shop, pets, rebirths, and codes. Bright icon buttons keep the core actions easy to scan.

ui:media:assets/UI/HUD.jpg.title: Fantasy game navigation
ui:media:assets/UI/HUD.jpg.description: A coordinated fantasy HUD with a compact top navigation bar and prominent Shop, Play, and Classes actions. Dark panels, warm borders, and consistent icons give the interface a cohesive style.
